title: Tej I Love You
desc: Tej, a young man, gets banished from his family for breaking his sister's marriage. He moves to London where he falls in love with a beautiful girl, Nandini.

title: Mandela
desc: In a small village, two political parties compete in the local elections and are ready to win at any cost. In a twist of fate, the single deciding vote comes down to a small-time barber.

title: Akshara
desc: A girl from a poor family joins a reputed college but falls into the trap of the college chairman and is sent to jail.

title: Kumki
desc: Bomman, a mahout, and his elephant are assigned to protect the crops of a hill tribe from a rogue elephant. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with the village leader's daughter.

title: Raid
desc: Inspector Prabhakaran takes an oath to eradicate criminals. However, chaos ensues when his fiancé gets killed in a crossfire.

title: Visithiran
desc: A retired policeman known for his investigative skills grieves the death of his wife. However, things take a turn when he gets embroiled in a human trafficking case.

title: Pathu Endrathukulla
desc: A driving instructor is tasked to deliver Shakeela, a young woman, to a landlord in Mussoorie. But soon, he finds out that her life is in danger and decides to be her saviour.

title: Thudikkum Karangal
desc: Balu works as a clerk in Ramesh's estate and is very loyal to him. However, when Ramesh accidentally kills Balu, the victim's brother Gopi becomes furious and decides to avenge his death.

title: Vengamamba
desc: Vengamamba's life becomes chaotic when her husband dies. Meanwhile, an ardent devotee of Lord Venkateswara tries to help her through difficult times.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Kaatrin Mozhi
desc: A housewife content with her life still sometimes dreams of independence. Later, her wishes come true when an unexpected opportunity to become a radio jockey arises.

title: Chennai 600028 II: Second Innings
desc: A group of friends reunite for the wedding of one of their own. However, when a mishap threatens to ruin the event, only a series of cricket matches can save the day.

title: Vaanam Kottattum
desc: After committing a revenge killing, a man serves time in prison, but the repercussions of his crime continue to haunt his family long after.

title: Ivan Sariyanavan
desc: Gana, a former army officer, embarks on a mission to eradicate corruption leading him to confront a dangerous politician and his oppressive empire.

title: Burma
desc: Burma, a car thief, steals expensive cars. However, chaos ensues, when he is forced to race against time in order to acquire cars for a dreaded gangster.

title: Vinaya Vidheya Rama
desc: Facing a menacing criminal kingpin, Ram fights to protect his family. Soon, he embarks on a daring mission to topple the villain and dismantle his corrupt empire.

title: Santharppavaathi
desc: Gautham, a security guard, comes across his grandfather's diary that takes him on a treasure hunt. Meanwhile, Sultan, a terrorist, holds a Pakistani archaeologist hostage to find a treasure.
